tasks.gr8-world-war-i-t4: Topic: World War I. Cover nationalism, alliances, trench warfare, propaganda, women in war, Delville Wood, the SS Mendi, and the Treaty of Versailles. Ask Grade 8 learners to analyse concise sources, sequence wartime events, and identify causes, consequences, and perspectives.
tasks.gr8-britain-home-front-world-war-i-t4: Topic: Experiences of World War I in Britain. Cover conscription and propaganda in Britain, conscientious objectors, music and poetry of the war, the changing roles of women in the workplace and Emily Pankhurst and the campaign for the vote. Ask Grade 8 learners to read short sources and poems, compare points of view, and explain cause and effect. Keep contested numbers out of questions.
